nodes.name: Back aboard
nodes.comments: Opening: the jungle survives in his senses; familiar mechanical faults make this ship feel like home. Original fan-written dialogue; complete thoughts are padded to native pages.
nodes.text:
I still wake expecting leaves
above me. Then the ventilation
starts, and I remember where I
am.
This ship is mine. I know the
welds, the wiring, the sound
of a tired bearing. Tonight I
need that certainty.
nodes.speaker: CONRAD

nodes.text:
Motor relays disconnected. I
can still hear you. Please do
not mistake an immobile body
for an empty one.
nodes.speaker: T-01

nodes.comments: Conversation turn. Completed activates the next speaker; no gameplay state is changed. Original fan-written dialogue.
nodes.text:
A face can be copied. So can a
voice. I need practice making
a decision before either one
makes it for me.
nodes.speaker: CONRAD

nodes.name: T-01 / droid training reply
nodes.comments: Conversation turn. Completed activates the next speaker; no gameplay state is changed. Original fan-written dialogue.
nodes.text:
Then watch what I do. I will
not return fire. Two hits will
cut motor power, and you may
speak to me afterwards.
nodes.speaker: T-01

nodes.name: CONRAD / droid wreck conrad
nodes.comments: Conversation turn. Completed activates the next speaker; no gameplay state is changed. Original fan-written dialogue.
nodes.text:
I hear you. Stay on backup
power. The chassis can wait; I
am not losing another record
to a hurried repair.
nodes.speaker: CONRAD

nodes.name: Inner safety door

nodes.comments: Use opens the console once. Log out resets the latch. Keep enabled so the terminal stays visible; its active state prevents repeated cycles.
nodes.doneText:
Inner hatch sealed. Outer
hatch released. The pressure
reading is stable. The
right-hand exit remains
available.
The workshop is still
accessible if you have
unfinished checks. I will not
mark them complete merely
because you can leave.

nodes.name: AURORA access screen
nodes.comments: Identity versus physical evidence. Choice 1 runs the real interlock sequence; choice 2 cancels. Original fan-written dialogue; complete thoughts are padded to native pages.
nodes.text:
Access confirmed. Pressure
check still required.
A name opens the control
panel. It cannot tell me
whether a seal will hold.
I will seal the inner hatch,
balance pressure, then release
the outer door.
nodes.speaker: AURORA

nodes.name: Ready for operator
nodes.comments: Initial state in the pressure state group. Cycling automatically exits it.

nodes.name: Equalizing pressure

nodes.name: Safe to depart
nodes.comments: Timer completion enters this state, exits Cycling, opens the outer hatch and lights the ready lamp.

nodes.name: Pressure equalized

nodes.text:
Inner hatch sealed. Pressure
equalized. The outer hatch is
released; the right-hand exit
is ready.
The door opened on a pressure
reading you can verify. I wish
the rest of your journey
offered the same assurance.
nodes.speaker: AURORA

nodes.doneText:
The diagnostic is stored. R-03
retains his event log. His
left joint still needs
mechanical alignment before
heavy work.
He can answer from beside the
bench. A working voice is a
reason to listen, not proof
that every fault is repaired.

nodes.name: R-03 maintenance log
nodes.comments: Choice 2 leaves the entire diagnostic untouched. Neither branch erases memory or repairs the joint mechanically. Original fan-written dialogue; complete thoughts are padded to native pages.
nodes.text:
R-03 kept recording after his
left actuator seized.
His event log is intact. The
interruption is in the joint,
not his memory.
A low-power scan can isolate
the fault without writing to
his memory bank.
nodes.speaker: AURORA

I can feel the command reach
my left arm again. The joint
still binds. Do not ask it to
carry your weight yet.
My event log is intact. You
asked about that before asking
whether I could work. I have
kept that entry, too.

nodes.comments: First turn of a three-node exchange about Conrad's missing context. Completed advances to Conrad. Original fan-written dialogue; complete thoughts are padded to native pages.
nodes.text:
You once asked me to record
every repair, including the
ones you later undid. I asked
how long to retain them.
You said: until I can explain
why I made them. Some entries
are still waiting.
nodes.speaker: R-03

nodes.name: CONRAD / r03 conrad reply
nodes.comments: Conversation turn. Completed activates the next speaker; no gameplay state is changed. Original fan-written dialogue.
nodes.text:
Did I ever ask you to erase an
entry?
nodes.speaker: CONRAD

nodes.name: R-03 / r03 memory reply
nodes.comments: Conversation turn. Completed activates the next speaker; no gameplay state is changed. Original fan-written dialogue.
nodes.text:
Once. The next morning you
asked what had been removed. I
could tell you the time and
size, but nothing else.
That was when you changed the
rule. I retain the mistakes
now. They are often the part
you ask about first.
nodes.speaker: R-03

nodes.name: CONRAD / r03 conrad close
nodes.comments: Conversation turn. Completed activates the next speaker; no gameplay state is changed. Original fan-written dialogue.
nodes.text:
Good. We can fix a joint and
leave a memory alone. Show me
the fault at the console.
nodes.speaker: CONRAD

A scanner gives me numbers. It
does not explain them.
I keep this optical bench
isolated. No network can
improve the evidence for me.
Receiver aligned. Shield
closed. One short pulse should
be enough.

The Death Tower taught me to
watch the gap before the
target. I would have preferred
a quieter lesson.
Here, each hit flashes green.
No audience, no score to sell.
I can practise from either
deck and leave by the same
door.

alignment. Letting it move
makes me choose my moment.

answers only to a hit.

as evidence of an impact.
The sensor registers contact
with the plate. Muzzle light
cannot make a miss count.

range trace. Standby dims the
workstation.

nodes.text:
I kept a range trace from
after New Washington. A quiet
room, an empty doorway. Space
to lower the pistol.
It looks unremarkable. That
was the point. I needed to
know which part of my aim was
training and which part was
fear.
nodes.speaker: CONRAD

nodes.text:
A gap in the firing circuit. I
can see daylight between the
contacts. No remote command
can bridge it.
The Morphs made a familiar
face unreliable. I will not
let that turn every machine
into another act of faith.
nodes.speaker: CONRAD

I recognise the corrections.
But how did I reach these
conclusions? A missing day can
take the reasoning with it.

visible until I can repeat the
work.

nodes.text:
The arm holds steady when my
hands cannot.
I still make it show each
movement before I let it near
a damaged memory connector.
No tool is fitted. A slow
sweep will check its reach.
nodes.speaker: CONRAD

nodes.comments: AURORA's restraint is a character trait. This is story context, not a new network-security or access-control subsystem. Original fan-written dialogue; complete thoughts are padded to native pages.
nodes.text:
Ship records are local. A
remote request cannot open a
hatch or change course without
a command from aboard.
That limits what I can do for
you. It also leaves a record
of what you chose. You asked
me to preserve that
distinction.
nodes.speaker: AURORA

nodes.name: Personal archive / display
nodes.comments: The emotional centre of the lab: recorded evidence does not remove uncertainty. No quotation from the original script. Original fan-written dialogue; complete thoughts are padded to native pages.
nodes.text:
My recorded voice once knew
more about my life than I did.
I still listen for the
hesitation.
A record can tell me what I
said. It cannot tell me
whether I was frightened,
mistaken, or speaking for
someone else.
Keep the original. Date every
copy. If a memory changes, I
want to know when it changed.
nodes.speaker: CONRAD

nodes.text:
A clearance code is on file.
No one has signed it.
An automated berth, perhaps.
Or an incomplete record. I
cannot tell which.
This console controls
displays. The central terminal
controls the pressure lock.

nodes.comments: Sensory memory connects the mundane machinery to Titan; the fan toggle remains safe during the airlock sequence. Original fan-written dialogue; complete thoughts are padded to native pages.
nodes.text:
On Titan, the air smelled of
wet leaves and hot machinery.
Here it passes through filters
I can reach and replace.
The cabin blower and airlock
pump have separate supplies. I
can silence the fan without
trusting my next breath to a
test.
nodes.speaker: CONRAD

nodes.comments: Survival habits rather than jokes about an instruction manual; inspecting the locker does not grant inventory items. Original fan-written dialogue; complete thoughts are padded to native pages.
nodes.text:
Seal tape, gloves, a tether. I
repack them in the same order.
When the lights go, my hands
need to find them without me.
The jungle left me with that
habit. Think while there is
time. When there is not, give
your body something it already
knows.
nodes.speaker: CONRAD

nodes.comments: Honest limitation: this short effect is not an equipment pickup or a complete EVA certification. Original fan-written dialogue; complete thoughts are padded to native pages.
nodes.text:
The suit is empty. We can test
its seal indicators.
A green lamp confirms this
circuit. It does not certify
every seam against vacuum.
I can pulse the indicators
now. A real departure requires
a full suit inspection.
nodes.speaker: AURORA

nodes.text:
The old plates keep every
impact. Some are grouped
neatly; others climb towards
the edge as my arm tires.
A summary would call both
sessions complete. The metal
tells me when to stop. I keep
the bad plates beside the good
ones.
nodes.speaker: CONRAD

nodes.name: Range supply cabinet / display
nodes.comments: A darker contrast with survival as spectacle, not another joke about improving aim. Original fan-written dialogue; complete thoughts are padded to native pages.
nodes.text:
Ear protection, lens cloths,
spare lamps. Small things that
never appeared in the Death
Tower broadcasts.
I remember how the crowd
filled the silences between
shots. In here I can hear a
bearing wearing out. I prefer
that warning.
nodes.speaker: CONRAD

nodes.text:
The firing height changes. The
plate follows the same rail.
Only a hit flashes the lamp.
Light around a shot cannot
make a miss count.
Live mode illuminates the
analysis screen; standby
leaves the target running.
nodes.speaker: AURORA

nodes.text:
I changed this bearing before
it failed. An uneventful entry
in the log. I would like more
of those.
The middle-deck computer holds
the carriage. Before anyone
works on the rail, it stays
there. Practice can wait.
nodes.speaker: CONRAD
